units.source_text: 匂亲王想不到薰中纳言是独宿的，

en.t: Prince Niou had not imagined that Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was sleeping alone.

units.source_text: 对二女公子说：“中纳言被当作主人看待，十分舒服，很可欣羡呢。”

en.t: He said to the two young ladies, "The Middle Counselor is being treated like the master here; he is very comfortable, and quite enviable."

units.source_text: 二女公子听了很怀疑，不知他和姐姐究竟有何关系。

en.t: When the two young ladies heard this, they became very suspicious, not knowing what relationship he really had with their elder sister.

units.source_text: 匂亲王千难万难，好容易到了这里，想起不久即将离去，心中苦未餍足，因此也很愁闷。

en.t: Prince Niou had overcome countless difficulties and only just managed to reach this place; when he thought that he would soon have to leave, his heart was painfully unsatisfied, and so he too was deeply distressed.

units.source_text: 但两女公子不解他的心情，她们只管悲叹：“不知这段姻缘究竟如何，将来是否被人耻笑？”

en.t: But the two young ladies did not understand his feelings; they only lamented, "Who knows how this marriage bond will turn out, or whether people will laugh at us in the future?"

units.source_text: 可知恋爱真是一件苦心劳思之事啊！

en.t: This shows that love truly is a matter of bitter anxiety and exhausting thought.
